claims.statement: The recorded exact bounded probe found no positive complete aggregate and no proper favorable selector among all eligible rows tested; it verifies root-independent polynomial recurrence evaluation on one fully specified eligible tree, but proves no universal selector or aggregate statement.
claims.scope: All labeled ordinary trees of orders 2 through 7, together with 40 deterministic Prüfer samples at each order 16 through 60 and every parameter satisfying x+2<=p and 3p<2 alpha+1 in those samples; root-invariance check on the first eligible order-17 sample only.
claims.reason: Literal subset enumeration and an independent include/exclude tree recurrence give reproducible bounded arithmetic, including every sampled eligible row and all selected leaf tags. No changed-membership eligible selector example was found, so the probe leaves the target and that selector phenomenon unresolved.

limitations: No proof or refutation of the universal lower-region aggregate was obtained.
No eligible proper-selector example or changed selector membership was found in the stated finite search; this is not evidence of impossibility.
The large-order work is seeded sampling, not exhaustive enumeration, and the results do not extend beyond the exact generation boundary recorded in EVIDENCE.json.
The root-independence check covers one tree fixture and does not establish a general selector-dependent recurrence invariant.
